parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The backup schedule ID. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs enable-backup-log --backup-plan-id dbstooi000000 --client-token dbs --enable-mysql-physical-backup-binlog true --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs EnableBackupLog --region cn-hangzhou --EnableMysqlPhysicalBackupBinlog true --BackupPlanId dbstooi000000 --ClientToken dbs
